headline: Candy Cane Countdown: Thanksgiving Week at the Holidays
tagline: The holiday season is in full swing, and the first handmade candy cane day lands Nov 27. Here's what to know before the Thanksgiving crowds.

lead.title: Handmade Candy Canes Start Pulling Nov 27
lead.body: Candy Palace at Disneyland and Trolley Treats at Disney California Adventure pull handmade candy canes on set days, starting Nov 27 (Disneyland) and Nov 28 (DCA). Wristbands are handed out in person at the shop with one cane per guest, so arrive early.

events.title: "it's a small world" Holiday
events.dates: Now open for the holidays; season runs through Jan 6, 2027
events.body: The ride's new holiday version reopened after its Oct 30 closure; one report says it opened a day early on Nov 12, others cite Nov 13. Check the app for current status.

events.title: Christmas Fantasy Parade
events.body: Santa, toy soldiers, dancing reindeer and Disney characters head down Main Street, U.S.A. One guide lists showings at 3:15 and 5:30 PM; confirm times in the app.

events.title: Believe… In Holiday Magic Fireworks
events.body: The holiday fireworks spectacular is back with seasonal music and simulated snowfall over Main Street.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: Pick up a map and stickers at a participating Downtown Disney shop ($11.99 plus tax per the fact sheet) and hunt for ornaments.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition of World of Color lights up Paradise Bay.

events.title: Festival of Holidays & Santa
events.body: Festive food marketplaces and the Sip and Savor Pass return to Disney California Adventure, with a mariachi holiday show on Buena Vista Street. Santa greets guests at the parks and hotels through Dec 24.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the mansion runs into the new year.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Handmade Candy Cane Schedule
events.body: Wristbands are given out in person at Candy Palace and Trolley Treats, and a mobile waitlist isn't expected this year. Sources disagree on the last Disneyland dates (Dec 21/23 vs 22/24, plus Dec 25), so confirm before you go.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa at Naples
events.body: A Downtown Disney breakfast with Santa. Reservations are open through Patina Group.

events.title: Lunar New Year Marketplaces Return
events.body: Disney's event page says the festival returns in 2027, with offerings subject to change. Dates haven't been announced; the 2026 run was Jan 23 – Feb 22.

events.title: Remember… Dreams Come True Returns
events.body: A refreshed version of the Disneyland fireworks spectacular is slated to return in February 2027. Nightly schedules haven't been announced.

tip: Thanksgiving week is busy. Hit the candy cane shop at park opening on Nov 27 (Disneyland) or Nov 28 (DCA) for a wristband.
caveats: Dates come from Disney press coverage and fan sites as of Nov 19, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
